app.title: Riptide
lang.label: Language
theme.label: Appearance
nav.label: Main navigation
column.name: Name
column.unrecorded: Not recorded: this download was added before Riptide tracked download time
column.resizeHint: Drag to resize, double-click to reset
failure.notfound: File not found on the server
failure.login.long: This video needs you to be signed in. Sign in to YouTube in your browser and try again.
failure.auth.long: The server asked for a user name and password that were missing or wrong. Choose Enter credentials and add them.
failure.denied.long: Access denied. The link may have expired, or the site needs you to sign in or send cookies.
failure.notfound.long: The server says this file does not exist (404/410). Check the link; retrying will not help.
failure.refused.long: The video site refused the request. Try again in a minute, or open Settings → About → Update video support.
empty.all.heading: Nothing here yet
empty.all.body: Paste a link, or let the browser extension send downloads straight here.
empty.view.heading: No downloads in this view
empty.view.body: Everything is in another list. Try All downloads.
empty.search.heading: No matches
empty.search.body: No download name or address contains that text.
remove.title: Remove from the list?
remove.one: {name} will be removed from the list.
remove.many: {n} downloads will be removed from the list.
remove.deleteFile: Also delete the files from disk
restart.title: Restart from the beginning?
restart.body: {name} will be downloaded again from zero. Everything received so far is discarded.
duplicate.title: Already in the list
duplicate.body: {name} is already in your downloads, with the same link or the same name in the same folder.
add.title: Add download
add.urlHint: Paste a direct link. Riptide checks it as you type.
add.urlInvalid: That is not a web address. It should start with http:// or https://.
add.notResumable: single connection, the server does not support ranges
add.noSpace: Not enough space in this folder: {free} free
add.browseSoon: The folder picker arrives in a later version.
add.checksumInvalid: A checksum is 32, 40 or 64 hex characters.
details.title: Download details
details.rangesYes: The server accepts byte ranges, so each stripe is one connection and the file resumes from where it stopped.
details.rangesNo: The server does not accept byte ranges: one connection, and a resume starts from the beginning.
log.verifying: Checking the file against its checksum
toast.openSoon: Opening files arrives in a later version.
toast.browserFailed: Could not change the browser integration. Details are in the log.
toast.extFolderFailed: The extension folder was not found in this install.
toast.extPageFailed: Could not open the browser. Is it installed?
toast.updateCheckFailed: Could not check for updates. Details are in the log.
toast.updateFailed: The update could not be installed. Details are in the log.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Changes apply immediately.
settings.langDesc: Interface language. The layout mirrors for Arabic.
settings.defaultDirDesc: Where new downloads go unless their category says otherwise.
settings.categoryDirsDesc: Leave a row empty to use the default folder.
settings.connectionsDesc: More connections help on fast links; 8 is right for most servers.
settings.perHostDesc: A cap across all downloads from the same host, so servers do not block you.
settings.speedLimitDesc: Leave bandwidth for everything else on the network.
settings.clipboardMonitorDesc: Offer to download links you copy.
settings.notifyOnCompleteDesc: A Windows notification with Open and Show in folder.
settings.markDownloads: Mark downloaded files as from the internet (recommended)
settings.allowPrivateRedirects: Allow public sites to redirect downloads to my local network
settings.allowPrivateRedirectsDesc: Off by default. Turn on only if a trusted service (a NAS relay, an intranet link) redirects to a local address and the download is refused.
settings.markDownloadsDesc: Windows then warns before you open a downloaded program or document, as it does for browser downloads. Needs an NTFS drive.
settings.confirmOnExit: Ask before closing with active downloads
settings.confirmOnExitDesc: Downloads resume on the next start either way.
settings.closeToTray: Keep running in the tray when the window closes
settings.browserDesc: Catch downloads from Chrome, Edge and Firefox. No admin rights needed.
settings.ext: Install the extension in Chrome or Edge
settings.extDesc: Chrome and Edge load a local extension in three clicks. Riptide ships the folder; no store, no admin rights.
settings.extStep1: Open the extensions page and turn on Developer mode (top right).
settings.extStep3: Pick the Riptide extension folder (the button below opens it), then pin the Riptide icon.
settings.proxyDesc: Use the Windows proxy, none, or your own.
settings.proxyUrlInvalid: Use http://, https:// or socks5:// followed by host:port, e.g. socks5://127.0.0.1:1080
details.speedLimitDesc: For this download only; the global limit in Settings still applies.
exit.title: Quit Riptide?
exit.body: Pause {count} downloads and quit? They continue where they stopped the next time you open Riptide.
settings.aboutDesc: Free and open source. No accounts, no ads, no tracking.
settings.channel.prerelease: Pre-release builds follow the beta channel.
settings.autoUpdateDesc: At most once a day, from GitHub Releases. This is the only connection Riptide makes besides your downloads.
settings.resetDesc: Puts every setting back to its default. Downloads are not touched.
empty.steps.title: How to start
empty.step1.title: Paste a link
empty.step1.body: Press Ctrl+N, or use Add download.
empty.step2.title: Pick a folder and the connections
empty.step2.body: Riptide checks the link and fills in the name and category.
empty.step3.title: Watch the stripes fill
empty.step3.body: Each stripe is one connection fetching its part of the file.
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.hint: Press ? anywhere to see this list again.
toast.autostartFailed: Could not change the Windows startup setting
add.mediaReady: Video found. Pick a quality below.
add.mediaPlainFallback: You can still add the link as a plain file.
add.mediaNoTools: Video support is not installed. Add it from Settings → About.
add.mediaDrm: This video is protected (DRM) and cannot be downloaded.
add.mediaLive: Live streams are not supported yet.
add.mediaUnsupported: Riptide could not find a downloadable video on this page.
add.mediaLogin: This video needs you to be signed in. Sign in to YouTube in your browser and try again.
add.mediaRefused: The video site refused the request. Try again in a minute, or open Settings → About → Update video support.
torrent.title: Add torrent
torrent.desktopOnly: Torrents work in the Riptide desktop app.
torrent.detected: This is a torrent link. Next you choose which files to download.
torrent.webSeed: This torrent also lists web seeds (HTTP mirrors). If few peers are online it can be slow or never start; the files can be downloaded from the web seed instead (a normal download, not checked against the torrent's piece hashes).
torrent.webSeedAdded: {n} file(s) added as normal downloads from the web seed
torrent.webSeedRefused: {n} file(s) were left out: their address is not a public web address.
torrent.noMagnetOnClipboard: There is no magnet link on the clipboard.
torrent.multiHint: Choose the files of each one in turn, or add them all now with every file selected.
torrent.addAllSummary: {added} added, {existing} already in your list, {failed} could not be read
torrent.queueMore: {n} more magnet link(s) wait after this one.
torrent.resolving: Finding peers and reading the file list…
torrent.resolvingHint: A magnet link does not contain the file list. Riptide asks other peers for it, which can take up to two minutes.
torrent.errTimeout: No peer answered in time, so the file list could not be read. Check the link, or try again later.
torrent.errMagnet: That magnet link is not valid.
torrent.errTorrent: That torrent is not valid or not safe to use.
torrent.errGeneric: The torrent could not be read: {error}
torrent.existing: This torrent is already in your list.
torrent.sequentialHint: Files are fetched in order, first file first. Useful when you want to open them while the rest downloads.
torrent.sequentialOn: Files are downloaded one after another.
torrent.hint: Pieces are checked as they arrive; a damaged piece is fetched again.
torrent.rechecking: Checking the files of {name} again. Pieces that are intact are kept.
settings.protocolsDesc: Open them with Riptide when you click one in a browser or double-click a file. Registered for your user only; no administrator rights.
toast.protocolsOn: Riptide now opens magnet links and .torrent files. Windows may ask you to confirm in Default apps.
toast.protocolsOff: Riptide no longer opens magnet links and .torrent files.
toast.protocolsFailed: Could not change the registration for magnet links and .torrent files.
settings.torrentSeeding: Keep sharing after a download finishes
settings.torrentSeedingDesc: Off by default. When off, a finished torrent stops all network activity.
settings.torrentRatioDesc: Uploaded divided by the size of the files. 0 means no limit.
settings.torrentMinutesDesc: How long to keep sharing a finished torrent. 0 means no limit.
settings.torrentUploadDesc: Applies to all torrents, also while downloading.
settings.torrentDhtDesc: Lets Riptide find peers without a tracker. Private torrents never use it. Applies after a restart.
settings.torrentPortDesc: 0 picks a free port automatically. Applies after a restart.
details.mediaHint: Video downloads are fetched and merged as a single file, so there is no per-connection map.
settings.videoMissing: Not installed. Update to download it.
settings.videoNoFfmpeg: yt-dlp {version} · ffmpeg missing (high qualities need it)
settings.videoPreview: Not available in the browser preview.
toast.videoUpdateFailed: Could not update video support. Details are in the log.
batch.title: Batch download
batch.patternHint: Use [001-120] for numbers, [a-z] for letters and [0-100:5] for steps. Several ranges multiply. Write \[ for a literal bracket.
batch.empty: Type a pattern to see the addresses it makes.
batch.listEmpty: Paste links or open a text file to see them here.
batch.error.not_http: The address must start with http:// or https://.
batch.error.invalid_char: The address contains a space or a character that is not allowed.
batch.error.unclosed: A [ has no closing ]. Write \[ for a plain bracket.
batch.error.invalid_range: That range is not valid. Examples: [1-10], [001-120], [a-z], [0-100:5].
batch.error.zero_step: The step must be at least 1.
batch.error.number_too_large: A number in the range is too large.
batch.error.too_many: This pattern makes more than {limit} links. Make the range smaller.
batch.ignored: {count} lines are not web addresses and were ignored
batch.addedSkipped: Added {added}; {skipped} skipped (already in the list or not valid)
batch.nothingAdded: Nothing was added: all {skipped} links are already in the list or not valid
queue.reorderHint: Drag to reorder, or press Alt + ↑ / ↓
queue.deleteBody: “{name}” will be deleted. Its {n} downloads move to the Main queue and keep their order. Nothing is deleted from your disk.
queue.deleteBodyEmpty: “{name}” will be deleted. It has no downloads.
queue.name: Name
queue.nameRequired: Enter a name for the queue.
queue.maxConcurrentMain: The Main queue follows the limit in Settings.
queue.moveNote: They go to the end of the queue you choose.
toast.queueDeleted: Queue deleted; its downloads are in the Main queue
shortcuts.moveInQueue: Move the selected download in its queue
schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.wraps: Runs overnight and stops the next morning.
schedule.startAt: Start once at a set date and time
schedule.startAtHint: The queue waits until then, and afterwards follows the hours above.
schedule.sleepNote: Riptide has to be running at that time. A sleeping or switched-off PC is not woken up: the queue starts as soon as the PC is on and Riptide is open.
schedule.issue.sameTime: Start and stop time must be different.
schedule.issue.startInPast: Choose a date and time in the future.
postaction.title: When the queue finishes
postaction.commandHint: Riptide starts exactly this program, with no options and no shell. Scripts (.bat, .cmd) are not run.
postaction.failed: The action could not be carried out: {error}
grab.title: Site grabber
grab.error.url: Enter a link that starts with http:// or https://
grab.error.size: Enter sizes as numbers of megabytes, with the smallest not above the largest.
grab.depthHint: How many links to follow from the start page. 0 reads only that page.
grab.offsite: Also list files hosted on other sites (a CDN, for example)
grab.typesHint: Leave all unticked to list every type.
grab.patternsHint: One pattern per line. * matches any name, ** matches folders too.
grab.sizeHint: Setting a size makes Riptide ask the server about every file, so the crawl takes longer.
grab.robots: Riptide always follows the site's robots.txt and keeps a polite pace. This cannot be turned off.
grab.stopped: Stopped. The files found so far are below.
grab.timeUp: Stopped: the time limit was reached.
grab.fileCap: The file limit was reached; some files are not listed.
grab.summary: {count} files will be added to your downloads.
menu.label: Application menu
shortcuts.jump: Jump to the first or last download
shortcuts.page: Move a page at a time
ai.title: AI assistant
ai.subtitle: Bring your own key. Optional, and off until you set it up.
ai.desktopOnly: AI settings are available in the desktop app.
ai.offHelp: AI stays off until you choose a provider, save your own API key and pick a model. Until then nothing is ever sent anywhere.
ai.providerDesc: Who runs the model. You pay them directly; Riptide takes no cut and has no account system.
ai.keyDesc: Stored only in Windows Credential Manager. It is never shown again, and never written to Riptide's settings, database, logs or events.
ai.keyNone: No key saved for this provider
ai.keyShow: Show or hide the key you are typing
ai.modelDesc: Pick from the provider's list, or type any model id.
ai.baseUrlDesc: For a compatible gateway. Must start with https:// (http:// only for localhost). Leave empty for the provider's own address.
ai.baseUrlInvalid: Not a valid endpoint: use https://, or http:// for localhost, without a query string.
ai.testResult: The key works and sees {n} models. Model list: {list} ms. A test reply from {model}: {complete} ms, {total} tokens ({prompt} in, {completion} out).
ai.testEstimated: Token counts are an estimate: the provider did not report usage.
ai.budgetDesc: Riptide refuses to call the provider once either limit is reached. Empty means no limit.
ai.privacyTelemetry: No telemetry and no accounts. Riptide talks only to the provider you chose, and only when you use an AI feature. Your API key never leaves Credential Manager except inside the request to that provider.
ai.history: Let the AI see my download history to avoid duplicates
ai.historyDesc: Off by default. When on, the titles of up to 25 recent downloads (never folders or paths) are added to Research requests.
ai.names: Suggest name and category in the Add dialog
ai.namesDesc: Off by default. Only the link's host, the file name (no query string) and the size are sent, and nothing is applied until you accept it.
ai.previewDesc: The exact messages of the most recent AI request. They are kept in memory only and disappear when Riptide closes.
ai.previewEmpty: No AI request has been made yet in this session.
ai.feature.name: Name suggestion
ai.forgetDesc: Deletes every saved API key, today's usage, the last request and these AI settings.
ai.forgetDone: AI keys, usage and settings deleted
ai.memoryDesc: Riptide remembers what you finished downloading (address, DOI, arXiv id, name and size, SHA-256) to warn you about repeats. It stays on this computer.
ai.memorySkipDesc: Off by default. When on, adding something you already downloaded (and still have on disk) is refused unless you choose Download again.
ai.error.not_configured: Choose a provider, save a key and pick a model first.
ai.error.daily_limit: The daily limit is used up. Raise it in Settings → AI or try tomorrow.
ai.error.unauthorized: The provider rejected the key. Check that it is correct and has access.
ai.error.rate_limited: The provider is rate limiting you. Wait a moment and try again.
ai.error.model_not_found: The model was not found for this key. Pick another one.
ai.error.timeout: The provider took too long to answer.
ai.error.network: Could not reach the provider. Check your connection or the endpoint.
ai.error.provider_down: The provider is having trouble. Try again later.
ai.error.budget: The session token budget is used up.
ai.error.invalid_response: The provider answered in a way Riptide could not understand.
ai.error.key_origin: This key was saved for a different address. Enter it again for this endpoint.
ai.error.store: Could not read or write the secure store: {detail}
seen.stale: You downloaded this on {date}, but the file is no longer on disk.
add.suggestPrivacy: Only the host, file name and size were sent. Nothing is applied until you accept.
add.suggestSame: The AI found nothing to improve.
research.title: Research
research.subtitle: Find open and public files: papers, books, music, films, games, software, images and data. Direct downloads only.
research.placeholder: What are you looking for? For example: open access papers about BitTorrent piece selection
research.useAi: Use AI to expand, rank and explain
research.keywordMode: Keyword mode: your words are sent to the open sources as they are. To expand the question, rank the results and explain each match, set up an AI provider.
research.none: Nothing with an open direct download matched. Try other words.
research.start: Type a topic above. Results come only from open sources, with direct download links.
research.addFailed: Could not add the selected results
research.noLicence: Licence not stated by the source
research.ai.dropped: {n} AI suggestion(s) ignored because they cited something outside the results
research.ai.failed: The AI step failed, so these are plain keyword results.
research.err.rate_limited: rate limited, try again in a minute
research.preview: What will be sent to the AI
research.previewDesc: The question-expansion request is shown below. The ranking request afterwards contains only result ids, titles, authors, years and short summaries, never links.
research.desktopOnly: Research needs the desktop app, which does the searching.
research.notice: Riptide searches open and public sources. Only download what you have the right to download.
research.footer: Riptide does not search torrent indexes, piracy or paywall-bypass sites: only open and public sources, with the licence shown whenever the source states one.
research.cancelled: Search stopped. What had arrived is below.
research.ai.ranking: AI is ranking the results… {n} so far
research.unavailable.jamendo: Add a free client id to include Jamendo
research.unavailable.web: Choose a web search in Settings
rs.title: Research sources
rs.subtitle: Two sources need something from you. Keys and ids are kept in the Windows Credential Manager, never in a file, and are sent only to their own service.
rs.jamendoDesc: Jamendo offers Creative Commons music. It needs a free client id from developer.jamendo.com. Without one, Jamendo is skipped.
rs.webDesc: Web results are pages, not files. "Find files on this page" then lists the files a page links to (robots.txt is respected). Choose where web results come from, or leave it off.
rs.braveDesc: Needs a token from the Brave Search API (a free plan exists). Your search words go to Brave.
rs.searxDesc: Use your own SearXNG instance (the address must serve JSON results). Public instances often block this. Your search words go to that server.
batch.seenBefore: {count} of these links were downloaded before and are still on disk. Switch on "Skip downloads I already have" in Settings → AI to leave them out.
